title: ActionRunner toasts 「操作已成功完成」 after every navigation: executeUrl returns { success: true } and handlePostExecution announces it, so a url action that only navigates claims a success
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a defect measured at a public door.** Walked on cloud staging on 2026-10-16 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2909). The os-dev on that card traced it into the console at objectui `ef71a09f` (cloud's `.objectui-sha`). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectui issue (pages 1–4 of the open list) names a navigation success toast, `executeUrl`, or `completedSuccessfully`.

## What the user sees

On the cloud control plane's home page, a button whose action is a plain navigation (`type: 'url'`, for example 「查看套餐」 `welcome_plan_view`) navigates and then raises the green toast 「操作已成功完成」. Nothing was done. The same holds for the pricing and billing pages' url buttons. On cloud#2909 the toast after the old 「邀请成员」 navigation made a user believe an invitation had been sent.

## Where (objectui `ef71a09f`)

- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: `executeUrl` (L1929) calls `navigateTo`, which returns `{ success: true }` (L2043, L2049, L2052) and is never `silent`.
- `handlePostExecution` (L1544) toasts every non-silent success with `completedSuccessfully` (L1525; zh 「操作已成功完成」).
- Seam: spec `InlineActionSchema` has no toast key (on `ActionSchema`, `toast` aliases `successMessage`), so the authoring side cannot silence it. The decision belongs in the runner.

## Done when

A navigation (`url` action, or any action whose only effect is a route change) raises no success toast unless the action declares a `successMessage`. A test pins both directions: a bare navigation stays silent, and a declared `successMessage` still shows.
